name: Distributed database for Orleans actor state saves

mentions.name: Distributed database for Orleans actor state saves
mentions.description: A distributed database built to serve actor state saves for the Orleans actor framework. It exploits Orleans' actor placement guarantees to implement storage optimized to those needs, running on a VPS with attached local storage instead of an external database, which is much cheaper and faster.
mentions.audience: External databases for actor state storage are more expensive and slower than using a VPS with attached local storage.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Taking on a fun technical challenge, building a distributed database to serve the needs of Actor State saves in Orleans. Using the guarantees around actor placement to implement something optimal for its needs.

Much cheaper to hire a VPS with attached local storage, than to use an external database and a lot quicker too.
